port_test.configuration: (FIFO_DEPTH, FEEDTHROUGH) = (1,0), (1,1), (2,0), (4,0) and (8,0), the cv32a60x instances; 2500 cycles each. The data widths are those of cv32a60x instances with the same parameters: 4, 38, 3, 64 and 35 bits. The write payload advances by 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15, truncated to the width, after each accepted write. Initial and midstream reset, backpressure, simultaneous transfers and repeated wrap.
port_test.comparison_scope: Feedthrough full/read may accept or defer write; accepted data must retain order and capacity. Internal pointers and invalid data are not compared.
port_test.environment: Linux, Python 3, Git, Verilator --binary --timing --public-flat-rw, C++ and make. CVA6_REPO must contain the recorded CVA6 and HPDcache submodule Git objects. VERILATOR may name its executable.
port_test.result: PASS (0) requires 12500 ordered observations, SUMMARY configurations=5 cycles=2500 observations=12500 errors=0, FIFO_PORT_TEST_COMPLETE and normal exit. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2). Build limit 120 seconds; run limit 10 seconds. CPU evaluation follows only after port-test PASS.
